summary: This stylesheet styles a terminal component with a header (containing macOS-style traffic light dots), body text, and interactive features like a copy button and blinking cursor. The design uses CSS custom properties (variables) throughout so that colors, fonts, and spacing can be changed in one place, and it handles special cases like converting markdown headings into shell comments.

explanations.24: Instead of hardcoding a font name like 'Fira Code', this uses a CSS variable that's defined elsewhere, so the entire site's code font can be changed by updating one variable.
explanations.58: The 'composes' keyword (from CSS Modules) means this class inherits all the styles from a global class called 'mk-eyebrow', so the title looks consistent with other eyebrow-style text on the page.
explanations.95: white-space: pre-wrap means the terminal respects line breaks and spaces in the original text, the way a real terminal would display them.
explanations.110: flex-shrink: 0 prevents the prompt symbol from shrinking even if the container gets tight — it always stays its natural size.
explanations.118: min-width: 0 overrides a flexbox default that would prevent this span from shrinking smaller than its content, allowing better text wrapping.
explanations.140: The transition property makes the opacity and color changes animate smoothly over 0.2 seconds instead of happening instantly.
explanations.147: rgb(255, 255, 255, 0.08) is white with 8% opacity — a semi-transparent white overlay that appears on hover.
explanations.163: fill: currentcolor means the SVG icon's fill color automatically uses whatever the text color (color property) is set to.
explanations.181: padding: inherit copies the padding from the parent element, and inset: 0 makes the overlay stretch to fill all four edges.
explanations.202: The animation 'blink 1s step-end infinite' makes the cursor blink on and off (using the keyframes defined above) every 1 second, repeating forever.
explanations.205: This media query checks if the user prefers reduced motion (like for accessibility reasons) and disables the blinking animation if so.
explanations.213: The :is() selector matches any heading level (h1 through h6) inside the terminal body, so they can all be reset to look like plain text.
explanations.225: The ::before pseudo-element adds the '#' characters before headings to make them look like shell comments instead of formatted headings.
